# unmask.tools

> unmask.shield is a free browser extension (Chrome, Microsoft Edge) that flags institutional euphemisms —
> language that abstracts real physical harm — wherever a user reads or writes it, and
> shows a plain-language translation anchored to a specific legal citation (Rome
> Statute, Geneva Conventions, Universal Declaration of Human Rights, or the Planetary
> Boundaries framework for ecological harm). Static phrase-matching runs entirely
> on-device by default, free, with no account required. An optional paid tier adds
> AI-assisted detection for phrases the static library misses, sending only the
> user-selected text (never a full page) to unmask.tools' own API — or a user can point
> it at their own local Ollama instance instead and never send anything to any
> company's servers. Built and operated by one person, Andreas Fleschurz, based in
> Austria, not a company.

## Product

- [Chrome Web Store listing](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/unmaskshield/fkhloolmcnkjhaiolbckmnjockmlecpo): install unmask.shield, free.
- [Microsoft Edge Add-ons listing](https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/unmaskshield/mlcikbjjdpgfmgjmhojkhabndfkomjmn): install unmask.shield, free.
- [Pricing](https://unmask.tools/pricing.html): free tier (static detection, every supported platform, permanent) plus paid tiers (Pro/Team/Enterprise) adding AI-assisted detection, team seats, a private company phrase repository, and MDM deployment.
- [Platform coverage](https://unmask.tools/tools.html): verified working on Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp Web, Telegram, Discord, LinkedIn, Proton Mail, Google Chat, Microsoft Copilot, Viva Engage, Microsoft Loop, plus manual scan mode for Google Docs, Word Online, PowerPoint, and PDFs.
- [FAQ / docs](https://unmask.tools/docs.html): how detection works, data handling, platform-by-platform notes.
- [Bot templates](https://unmask.tools/templates.html): system prompts for Claude Projects, Gemini Gems, and Custom GPTs that apply the same plain-language, law-anchored framework to a chatbot's own output.

## Data and transparency

- [Report page](https://unmask.tools/report.html): the live, public dataset — every phrase flagged across all users who opt in, fully anonymized, filterable by severity, sector, country, and time period.
- [Data Room](https://unmask.tools/dataroom.html): dataset licensing for research/commercial use, sample export.
- [Privacy policy](https://unmask.tools/privacy.html)
- [Terms of service](https://unmask.tools/terms.html)

## Press

- [Press kit](https://unmask.tools/press/): the full narrative press release, sourcing, and origin story.
- [Journalist verification guide](https://unmask.tools/press/verification-guide.html): real, testable claims — no unverifiable assertions.
- [Technical FAQ](https://unmask.tools/press/technical-faq.html) and [Non-technical FAQ](https://unmask.tools/press/non-technical-faq.html) for press.
- [Media kit](https://unmask.tools/press/media-kit.html): logos, screenshots, downloadable assets.

## What this is not

unmask.shield does not block, hide, or edit any content. It underlines a flagged phrase and shows a translation and citation on click; the original text is never altered. It is not affiliated with any government, NGO, or news organization — an independent project.
